title: Amaziah's Victory over Edom and Defeat by Israel
description: King Amaziah of Judah defeats Edom in the Valley of Salt and captures Sela. Arrogantly, he challenges King Joash of Israel but loses the battle at Beth-Shemesh. Joash takes Amaziah prisoner, breaks down part of Jerusalem's wall, and loots the temple and the king's treasures. Later, Amaziah is killed in a conspiracy after fleeing to Lachish.
